caption_L1: This line diagram is labeled Phthalic anhydride production in the United States from 1990 to 2019 (in 1,000 metric tons). There is a linear scale from 0 to 500 along the y-axis, marked Production in thousand metric tons. There is a linear scale from 1990 to 2015 on the x-axis, marked Year.
caption_L2L3: Between 1990 and 2000, Phthalic anhydride production increased steadily, to a peak in 2000. 2000 to 2005 saw a steady reduction in Phthalic anhydride production and 2005 to 2010 shows an even steeper decline. From 2010 to 2020, Phthalic anhydride production has plateaued somewhat but the overall trend is negative. Average Phthalic anhydride production is between 250 and 300 thousand metric tonsThere has been a slight increase in production from 2018 to 2020.
